integrity: The exact finite domain comprises 8568 five-element subsets; two complete independent graph encodings and forest algorithms reconstruct all 252 states, 630 edges, component classes and distances. Degree-count lower bound is a separate proof. No independent external scientific audit performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact computation-assisted theorem for the 18-vertex Pappus graph only; no all-cubic theorem, no novelty guarantee against inaccessible/unindexed records. The complete text of the highly relevant 2023 reconfiguration paper was not obtained; its same-size cubic example may have unverified overlap.
title: Seven exchange components of minimum decycling sets in the Pappus graph
